# Located

> Located is a private family location sharing app for parents and kids. It shows a live family map, sends arrival and departure alerts and keeps a 6-month location history. Available on iPhone (iOS 15.6+); Android is coming soon. 7-day free trial, then €9.99 / £9.99 / $9.99 per year for the whole family. Location data is encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold, and the app shows no ads. Built in Ireland. As of October 2026; last reviewed 20 October 2026.
